name: Inbox Desk
office_task: Each weekday, read the shared business inbox, file every message against its job or supplier, and hold every real reply for a named person.
systems_of_record: the mail system that issues the message_id (the shared Gmail or Outlook mailbox)
the job system or ledger that holds the job and supplier records messages are filed against
the exception desk the business runs, holding the queue table and its items

emits.write: an item on the exception desk naming the person who owns it, one per thread: a message waiting on its queue owner's reply, an unmatched message left as a task, a complaint handed whole to a person, or an item past its kind's clock handed to the owner's manager
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id (the item id), and reading the record back by message_id returns the item with its kind, record_ref, owner, due date and every outbound with who released it; no item back means nothing was raised and the message is escalated to the other queue's owner
